details.description: Indulge in the delightful crunch and irresistible flavour of Malkist Cappuccino Cracker Biscuits. Crafted with precision, these biscuits feature 14 layers of crunchy goodness, providing a truly satisfying texture. Coated with a silky cappuccino cream on one side and a delicate sugar sprinkle on the other, these biscuits offer a harmonious balance of flavours that will delight your senses. Enriched with multivitamins and malt, Malkist Cappuccino Cracker Biscuits are not only a delectable treat but also a nourishing snack to keep you energised throughout the day. Sourced from an ISO:22000 certified factory, these high-quality imported biscuits are a perfect choice for sharing with your loved ones during gatherings, movie nights, or as a special indulgence. Discover the perfect combination of crunch, flavour, and nutrition with Malkist Cappuccino Cracker Biscuits.
